narrativeProgression.description: The woman introduces herself as Marama Davidson, a member of Parliament from New Zealand.
She states that the Israeli Occupation Forces have taken them hostage, emphasizing their peaceful intentions as women standing for peace.
She criticizes the Israeli Occupation Forces' actions, arguing that they had no reason to kidnap them and prevent their journey to Gaza.
She concludes by calling for global pressure on the Israeli government for their immediate and safe release.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Mae name is Marama Davidson, I am a member of Parliament from New Zealand.
If you are watching this now, it is because the Israeli oppression forces have taken us.
We are peaceful women who stood by principles of peace, and the Israeli oppression forces had no reason to kidnap us, to take us hostage.
They could have just let us through to Gaza. They had no reason to do that.
Obviously, they have chosen to oppress us women, and I have now been taken.
We need the world to pressure the Israeli government for our immediate and safe release.

youtube_description:
Marama is an environmentalist and human rights advocate. She is currently a member of the New Zealand Parliament as a representative of the Green Party. She worked for the Human Rights Commission from 2003 to 2012. She has worked part-time for Breastfeeding New Zealand, she was a ‘Think Tank Member’ for the Owen Glenn Inquiry on Child Abuse and Domestic Violence, and founding member of Te Wharepora Hou Māori Women’s Collective.

Marama has six children.

QUOTE: “I am participating in the Women’s Boats to Gaza flotilla to highlight the crucial role of women in keeping their communities afloat, particularly in post-conflict situations. As an indigenous woman myself, I want to stand alongside the women of Gaza and to draw attention to the ongoing humanitarian crisis there.”

Video by Yudit Ilany, Israel Social TV
